messages.en:
{07 16 00}Man, I have been fighting
a NASTY bug until just
recently, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Someone named {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} 
{ff 00 00 00}gave me some {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00},
though, and I got better...
{07 14 00}Good thing, too.{01 00 00 05 00} I was
having these weird dreams
about space chickens.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mees, ma võitlesin kuni
hiljutise ajani ühe NÕMEDA
pisikuga, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Keegi nimega {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} 
{ff 00 00 00}andis mulle {ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}
ja ma sain terveks...
{07 14 00}Hea ka.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma nägin neid
imelikke unenägusid
kosmosekanadest.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I just recently turned the
corner on a really nasty
cold, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}...
{07 00 00}Boy, without the {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}
{ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}gave me...

{07 15 00}I might've started losing
some serious muscle mass,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma sain alles hiljuti
üle ühest väga nõmedast
külmetusest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}...
{07 00 00}Poiss, ilma {ff 00 00 07}rohuta{ff 00 00 00},
mille {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}mulle andis...

{07 15 00}oleksin võinud kaotada
tõsiselt lihasmassi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I had one brutal cold for a
while there, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}but now I feel
totally great!
{07 0a 00}And it's all because good
ol' {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}got me
{ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} What a pal!
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, if you see
{ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, say "ROCK ON!"
for me, OK?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mul oli seal mõnda aega
jõhker külmetus, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}aga nüüd
tunnen end suurepäraselt!
{07 0a 00}Ja seda kõike sellepärast,
et {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}tõi mulle
{ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Milline semu!
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kui sa näed
{ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, ütle minu poolt
„ROKI EDASI!”, eks?
